About the show

After accidentally activating her, Henry finds himself drawn to an eerily lifelike machine that knows everything about him, anticipates his every need, and curates his memories to make him feel like the good man he’s always believed himself to be. From Amy Conway (The Haunting of Agnes Gilfrey)...
